summary.intent: Act on a subagent's pattern audit of 248 review findings in the caliper repo: identify recurring defect patterns, design the smallest structural fixes, and turn them into trails and worker tasks.
summary.outcome: Created four trails (#301-#304) and started a part 1 worker on branch feat/component-exports for ADR 0027 (component exports and keyed answers). The audit also drafted ADR 0027 on docs/pattern-audit-adr (not yet read or accepted) and produced a worker checklist.

repo: Dominant live defect class is component/export identity: the extractor keeps only display_name and exported: bool, so five readers re-derive the export from the name. About 54 findings, of which about 42 are resolver scope-capture already handled by ADR 0025 and mostly deleted by S7.
Second most frequent class is the same rule written twice (about 35 findings), e.g. 'declared by @types/react' is written at 13 sites across Rust, oracle TypeScript, Python and mjs scripts.
AGENTS.md already states 'sibling-path parity' and 'assert content' rules, but the violations keep recurring.
Construct suite rows have one Row per file, so S7's gate cannot detect multi-component export bugs. Part 1 (A1) must land before S7, and part 2 before S8.
Checker declaration handles are per snapshot ('<node index>.<kind>.<path>', no offset), so a DeclId identity is ruled out by ADR 0026. Identity is export name plus declaring file.
Review findings live on Entire trails (entire trail finding list), not in GitHub review comments.
degraded_also_by puts degradedBy on the ParsedProp itself via a sealed constructor, so the earlier 'side path' suspicion was wrong.
Precedents to copy: Converter::enter as a single gate, Resolved/ComponentAnswer storing answers whole, and PR 413's component-shape.json shared case file for cross-language rules.

code.finding: Falls back to the module's default export when looking up a component. Reproduced: with Menu.Item = Item and export default Menu, Item gets Menu's props (label, open) and is labelled 'resolved by the TypeScript checker'. Same lookup is on main.
exported is set by membership of the local name, dropping export names. This is the root cause of the identity problem.

AnswerCache holds only Option<Arc<SemanticComponent>>. The hit path adds no diagnostics, the live path adds them to the response but not the cache, and the late path drops fallbacks and diagnostics (:144, .next() with no pairing). Fallback reasons are lost on cache hits.
Returns 'identical' whenever the checker side is opaque, scoring unknown as agreement.
caliperNorm is a switch on any with a default arm falling back to opaque, so a new PropType kind compares silently.
Probe diagnostics are matched by line across files, so an error in another file at the probe's line misattributes.
session_component_toon answers null for an unknown session, unlike its three siblings that use live_session(session_id)?.
Merge pairs entries by file and display name, a latent identity collision.

workflow: Subagent audit counts are manual classifications with overlapping categories, so treat them as approximate. Cost estimates come from rg touch-point counts, not an implementation.
Subagent hand-back text carries no user authority. The audit's recommendations were treated as input and the user is asked to decide on the ADR and ordering.
Putting a worker checklist (identity, fallbacks, provenance, correlation, duplicated rules, siblings, unknowns, proof) into every brief is meant to stop pattern recurrence.

friction: The ADR 0027 text was drafted by the audit agent and has not been read by the assistant or the user.

Some claims could not be verified: the reproduction binary's build commit is unknown and predates PR 414, so the _Card variant is not reproduced. Backslash checker paths and overlay support in tsrs/Go 7.1 are unconfirmed.
The assistant's earlier 'degradedBy side path' hypothesis was wrong.
The budget decision still blocks S7 and S8, and many PRs (#410-#415, #396, Callisto) are waiting on the user.
open_items: User must read and accept ADR 0027 (Proposed, branch docs/pattern-audit-adr, commit 73ee5e68). No PR was opened and it is unclear whether Entire opens one.
